change: Ecosystem passes (Creator, Studio, Business) are now the only recurring plans — individual apps moved to once-off packs.
details:
The Hub is now the single source of truth for all recurring billing. Individual Resonance apps have shifted to once-off credit and project packs, and the three ecosystem passes (Creator, Studio, Business) bundle cross-app usage under one monthly plan.

Existing monthly app subscribers keep their access under a legacy plan label until their next renewal window, at which point they can move to a pass or to once-off packs — no forced migration.

change: Once-off pack pricing is published. The Starter Pack is R99; pack checkout remains on the launch waitlist while one-time fulfillment is completed.
details:
ePublisher moved from a per-month plan to project- and credit-based packs. A new R99 starter pack shows the intended first-book allowance without committing to a subscription. One-time pack payment and automatic fulfillment are not live yet, so this route remains a waitlist.

Existing subscribers keep their unused monthly allowance and can top up with packs at any time.

change: Creative credit packs launched with faster poster + social-kit generation via the Hub proxy.
details: Creative Studio now routes paid generation through the Hub proxy, which enforces tier checks server-side and improves render times for posters and full social kits. Credit packs replace the old monthly plan; unused credits never expire.

change: The Sync Vision storyboard workflow is live. Pack pricing is published, while one-time PayFast checkout remains on the launch waitlist.
details: Sync Vision's redesigned storyboard workflow is live: shot lists, character sheets, and scene prompts are generated in one pass. Pack prices are published in ZAR; one-time PayFast settlement and automatic fulfillment are still being wired and tested.

change: YouTube Optimizer is live at youtube.reson8.life with channel audit, thumbnail, and growth pack entry points.
details: The canonical youtube.reson8.life domain is active with channel audit, thumbnail generation, and growth playbook entry points.

change: Free pilot open to schools and learners. Per-report and district packages arrive later in 2026.
details: Career Compass is in an open free pilot for schools, counsellors, and individual learners. The pilot covers career-path discovery, skills mapping, bursary matching, and role-fit insights. Per-report pricing and district/school-wide packages roll out later in 2026 — pilot participants keep free access through the launch.

change: New season live — free episodes, media kits, and shop. Never a subscription.
details: The new season is streaming on the podcast site with free episodes, downloadable media kits, and a merch shop. The podcast is intentionally never gated behind a subscription.

change: Resonance Constitutional Governance Framework v1.0 published — how we build, price, and evolve every app.
details:
RCGF v1.0 is the constitutional framework that governs how every Resonance app is built, priced, and evolved. It codifies our principles around user sovereignty, honest pricing, transparent AI usage, and pass/pack alignment across the ecosystem.

The framework is public, versioned, and referenced directly in the AI prompts that power our optimization protocol.
